Hi Daniel / Sarah,

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood — excited to get the POC started. Per our call, we'd like to schedule a 90-minute POC kickoff + hands-on working session where we'll:
- Review target prompts and success criteria
- Walk through routing policy options (model selection, fallback rules, regions, tiering)
- Run light load tests and confirm telemetry/metrics

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue Mar 9, 10:00–11:30
- Tue Mar 9, 14:00–15:30
- Wed Mar 10, 09:00–10:30

Attendees (from our side): Dylan (SE), Stephanie (PM), Dev (SRE/infra), Laura (CS). Please let me know which slot works best or share two slots that do.

I've attached a short draft agenda and a routing policy template so we can pre-populate model candidates and fallback ideas. Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1POC-Agenda-Draft

If you'd like us to run a short pre-check (credentials, network) beforehand, we can schedule a 30-min prep call.

Thanks,
Marissa
